assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Unspecified cardiac arrhythmia is coded I49.9
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded CPT 93229
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying rhythm disturbances and to guide further management
Coordination of Benefits is coded CO-22
CO-22 does not address this medical necessity determination
The claim is denied solely on the CO-22 basis

The clinical indication note supports that Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is required to correlate the patient's symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances and to guide further management
